comparison.objective: Commission a compact damper versus lower a hoisted motor onto four studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-tool unlocking and fine rotary adjustment versus bimanual pendant actuation, load steering, and multi-stud alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe carriage stops versus all feet flat over studs, chain slack, hands released, and no under-load, pinch, or high-speed stud strike event.
comparison.reason: Both involve industrial equipment and physical control actuation, but their tested abilities are materially different. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits are undeclared.
